name: SENCO UF GRAVITY WATER PURIFIER
summary: The Gravity Water Purifier – 25 Litre is a non-electric, gravity-based water purifier designed to provide safe and healthy drinking water without the need for electricity.
intro: The Gravity Water Purifier – 25 Litre is a reliable, non-electric water purification system designed to provide clean and safe drinking water for homes, offices, schools, and rural areas. Using advanced gravity-based filtration, it effectively removes suspended particles, precipitated iron, bacteria, cysts, and chlorine odour without the need for electricity or chemicals. With a 25-litre storage capacity, 16 litres per hour flow rate, and a filter life of over 5 years, it delivers safe drinking water with virtually zero running cost.
features: Comprehensive Purification – Removes suspended particles, precipitated iron, bacteria, cysts, and chlorine odour.
25 Litre Storage Capacity – Ideal for families, offices, schools, and community use.
High Flow Rate – Delivers up to 16 litres of purified water per hour.
Electricity-Free Operation – Works completely without electricity, making it ideal for power outages and remote locations.
Long Filter Life – Durable filter with a lifespan of more than 5 years under normal usage.
Zero Running Cost – No electricity consumption or expensive consumables required.
Continuous Operation – Purifies water whenever water is available, ensuring uninterrupted access to safe drinking water.
Low Maintenance – No moving parts for reliable performance and minimal maintenance.
No Chemical Regeneration Required – Operates continuously without regeneration, reducing maintenance time and cost.
Premium Food-Grade Containers – Built with high-quality, durable materials for long-lasting performance and hygiene.
Safe Drinking Water – Ensures fresh, clean, and healthy water for everyday use.
